hooks.text: Many believe the Radium Girls didn't know the paint was toxic.
Why did teenage girls lick radioactive paint for pennies a day?
Factory owners wore lead while telling girls radium was safe.

title: Why Did the Radium Girls Glow in the Dark? 🤯
description: In 1917, factory workers were told to lick radioactive paintbrushes while their bosses wore lead masks and used tongs.

beats.text: Many believe the Radium Girls didn't know the paint was toxic.
beats.visual: Close-up of a vintage watch dial with glowing green numerals, 1920.

beats.text: In 1917, young factory workers painted glowing watch dials for pennies.
beats.visual: The United States Radium Corporation factory in Orange, New Jersey, 1917.
queries: United States Radium Corporation factory Orange New Jersey

beats.text: To keep brushes sharp, supervisors told them to use their lips.
beats.visual: A fine-tip camel hair paintbrush held between two fingers, 1920.
queries: Fine tip paint brush camel hair

beats.text: Management insisted the luminous paint was as safe as medicine.
beats.visual: Vintage Westclox Big Ben alarm clock with radium dial, 1920.
queries: Westclox Big Ben alarm clock vintage

beats.text: While the girls licked brushes, the plant owners wore lead masks.
beats.visual: Scientists working with radioactive materials behind lead shields, 1920.

beats.text: Executives used tongs for the radium the girls put in their mouths.
beats.visual: Laboratory tongs grasping a small vial containing radium salts, 1920s.

beats.text: In 1928, Grace Fryer sued to expose this deadly corporate deception.
beats.visual: Portrait of dial painter Grace Fryer in her twenties, 1920.

beats.text: The world finally realized why dial painters were told to lick.
beats.visual: Front page of the New York World detailing the Radium Girls settlement, 1928.
queries: New York World Radium Girls trial article

better_than_last: Used the myth_vs_fact structure to emphasize the corporate deception of management using protection while workers were told to lick radioactive paint.
